name: warrior_quake
note: warrior: the ground splits in ember cracks, slabs of rock thrown up (Earthbreaker, Colossus Fall)

name: warrior_gyre
note: warrior: two steel crescents sweep a full circle at blade height (Reaping Gyre)

name: warrior_bellow
note: warrior: an iron war cry; chevrons and broken rings rush outward (Iron Bellow)

name: juggernaut_bulwark
note: juggernaut: an iron tower shield slams down before the caster and cracks the ground (Iron Bellow)

name: berserker_rage
note: berserker: blood flames tear up around the caster, droplets spray and fall (Red Frenzy, Bloodrage)

name: berserker_cleave
note: berserker: a huge crimson crescent falls overhead and splits the ground (Skyfall Cleave)

name: ranger_pierce
note: ranger: a fletched arrow strikes and splits; feathers and amber splinters burst (Dawnpiercer)

name: ranger_arrowfall
note: ranger: two arrows drop steeply and stick in the ground, a puff of dust (Hail of Dawn, each tile)

name: ranger_thornseal
note: ranger: a ring of thorned vines grows from the earth, amber motes rise (Blessed Earth)

name: ranger_canopy
note: ranger: leaves whirl up into a canopy around the caster, a gust of wind (Lightward)

name: deadeye_mark
note: deadeye: a reticle closes on the target, then a piercing flash and cracks (Final Verdict)

name: beast_spirit
note: beastmaster: claw rakes tear the ground, paw prints and spirit wisps of amber and green (Wild Bond)

name: mystic_mend
note: mystic: prismatic petals spiral up and open, rose and cyan motes (Purifying Wellspring, Mirror Mend)

name: elementalist_glyph
note: elementalist: a rune circle in three arcs of fire, frost and storm turns and flares (Falling Pyre)

name: illusion_mirror
note: illusionist: four mirror panes rise around the target, a glint crosses them, they shatter (Hall of Mirrors)

name: illusion_shatter
note: illusionist: a figure breaks into glass shards of cyan and rose (Umbral Stride)

name: thief_vanish
note: thief: low smoke billows from the feet, two dagger glints spin out (Shadow Veil, Shadow Mend)

name: ninja_vanish
note: ninja: an ink slash crosses the spot, ink drops and leaves whirl (Shadow Step)

name: ninja_smoke
note: ninja: a smoke bomb tile; grey puffs and a red spark (Smoke Bomb, each tile)

name: samurai_focus
note: samurai: a blade gleam rises before the caster, crimson petals circle it (Bushido Focus)

name: samurai_parry
note: samurai: crossed blades flash, sparks and a crescent of steel (Counter Stance)

name: necro_curse
note: necromancer: a violet brand of runes closes on the target, a green skull mark sinks in (Withering Curse)

name: lich_rot
note: lich: rot bubbles swell and burst on the target, green skull wisps rise (Soul Rot)

name: monk_heel
note: monk: a ring of chi sweeps at kick height, ember footfalls flare (Whirling Heel)

name: shadowfist_mark
note: shadowfist: five violet pressure points light up on the target, joined, then pulse (Pressure Points)

name: ironsage_ward
note: iron sage: jade hexagon plates close into a dome over the target and crumble (Chi Ward)

name: templar_mend
note: templar: a cross of gold light descends, feathers drift down (Vow of Mending, Lay on Hands)

name: inquisitor_zeal
note: inquisitor: white-gold holy flames rise in a ring, sparks climb, a brand circle (Zealotry)

name: sentinel_aegis
note: sentinel: three radiant wall panes rise around the caster under a dome of light (Aegis of Faith)

name: snare_jaws
note: snare: iron jaws snap shut on the tile, sparks and dust (Snare Trap, triggered)

name: snare_blast
note: snare: a mine bursts; ember shards, iron fragments and smoke (Seeker Mine, Detonate Mines)

name: vigil_wrath
note: vigil: a red war banner with a sword rises from the ground (Vigil of Wrath)

name: vigil_iron
note: vigil: a steel banner with a shield rises from the ground (Vigil of Iron)

name: vigil_haste
note: vigil: a green banner with a wing rises from the ground (Vigil of Haste)

name: vigil_clarity
note: vigil: a blue banner with an eye rises from the ground (Vigil of Clarity)
